HARD RULE for packages/functions: never write `await import(...)` of a local module — .babelrc keeps import() native and Node throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in prod (jest hides it). Lazy-load with require().
Shopify bulk export JSONL: with nested connections each child is its own line carrying `__parentId`; read how handlers/jobDataMigrate.js and the chunk processing (services/jobDataMigrate.service.js) consume the export before changing the query. Bulk queries carry routing markers (`#bulkElasticsearchExport...`) — never drop one.
i18n: translations under packages/assets/src/locale/translations/*.json are generated by `yarn update-label`, which needs an API key you do not have. For each new key add it to the component's own JSON (e.g. ChecklistItem's json / the Issue json the existing Issue.checklist.emptyImageAlt keys live in — find it with grep) AND add a real translation to all 14 translation files (da de en es fr it iw nb nl origin pt-BR sv vi zh-CN), editing only the lines you add, keeping each file's formatting.

TASK es-image-alt — move the Image alt checklist item onto the search index.
1. Export: graphql/mutation/bulkElasticsearchExportProduct.graphql add product media images with alt (e.g. `media { edges { node { ... on MediaImage { alt } } } }` or the shape the existing nested fields use); bulkElasticsearchExportCollection.graphql and bulkElasticsearchExportBlog.graphql add `altText` to the `image` already exported (featuredImage/image were added in commit 5415d9821b4 — keep `imageUrl`). Update graphql/mutation/__tests__/bulkElasticsearchExport.test.js.
2. transformDocument (handlers/jobDataMigrate.js) — or wherever child lines are folded into the parent doc — writes `imageCount` and `missingAltCount` (numbers) on product/collection/article docs; alt null/empty/whitespace = missing. A resource with no image: imageCount 0, missingAltCount 0. If media children arrive as separate JSONL lines, fold them into the parent before indexing; prove it with a test using a realistic JSONL sample.
3. The per-doc verdicts that fill `checklistIssues` (find where `checklistIssues` is computed, STORE_ISSUE_PREDICATES in services/audit/storeScan.js) add `emptyImageAlt` when missingAltCount > 0 and make emptyImageAlt a store-scope item (const/seoIssues.js `scope`) so listStoreIssuePages + the pages modal list those resources like Meta title does.
4. readStoreResources (services/audit/storeScan.js) adds `sum` aggregations of imageCount and missingAltCount; EmptyImageAlt.audit reads them from the storeResources artifact: requiredArtifacts ['storeResources']; storeResources null → notChecked (same as the other store items); otherwise status = missing === 0, failedCount = missing images, scannedCount = total images.
5. Remove the checklist's separate count: artifacts/imageAltReport.js, applyImageAltResult.js and the emptyImageAlt branch in runner.js (~L72-90) and in handlers/webhook/bulkOperationHook.js that feeds the checklist, plus their now-dead tests (applyImageAltResult.scanning.test.js, runnerAltReread.test.js) — but FIRST grep every caller: the Image optimizer page and optimizeReport counts must keep working; remove only the checklist path. EmptyImageAlt.fromCounts goes if nothing else uses it.
6. const/jobDataMigrate.js CHECKLIST_INDEX_VERSION 3 → 4, with the WHY in the existing comment style (old index lacks imageCount → would read as 0 missing).
7. Frontend: the item's summary text keys (Issue.checklist.emptyImageAlt.*) must still read right with failedCount/scannedCount; check packages/assets/src/const/checklistItems.js for the item's layout and make it the store layout (page-type rows + View pages) like metaTitle if the store items use one.
Tests: storeScan tests (aggregation + predicate), handlers/__tests__/jobDataMigrate.test.js (fold + counts), an EmptyImageAlt audit test (notChecked when null, counts otherwise).
Rules: touch only files in the contract allow list. TDD: failing test first, watch it fail. Comments say WHY only (a constraint, a Shopify limit, a unit), never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners. Backend logging via @functions/helpers/logger with [fnName] + shopId, never console.*. No secrets, no new dependencies (cheerio is already a dependency — check packages/functions/package.json), do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml. Run every verify command yourself and format with `DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --fix <changed files>` (the pre-commit hook rejects prettier errors). Final message: file:line per change, what you removed, and anything in the brief you could not do and why.
